name: Precise Inputs
description: Buffers a click by 1-3 ticks and only registers it once it is safe.

active.name: Enabled
active.description: Turn Precise Inputs on or off. Also available in the pause menu.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: A click is delayed by at most this many ticks to reach a safe moment. If no safe moment exists inside the window, the click registers instantly (no delay).

toggle-key.name: Toggle key
toggle-key.description: Press to turn Precise Inputs on or off.
